title: Elevate UI Design: Master CSS 'text-wrap: balance' for Harmonious Headings
tweet: Improve UI readability and aesthetics! Learn how CSS 'text-wrap: balance' automatically optimizes heading line breaks for a cleaner, more harmonious design. Essential for modern web typography! #CSSTypography #UIDesign #WebFonts #UserExperience
tip: The 'text-wrap: balance' property is a game-changer for short blocks of text, especially headings and captions. It tells the browser to intelligently balance the lines of text to prevent awkward widows or orphans, creating a more visually pleasing and readable UI. This significantly enhances the perceived quality and professionalism of your site's typography without manual line break adjustments, directly improving user experience.
